queries.query: "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Locate core literature applying LLMs directly to network configuration, intent translation, and NetOps workflows.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" OR "intent-driven" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Find work on translating high-level intent/natural language into concrete network configs—a central NetOps task for LLMs.

queries.query: "configuration repair" OR "config repair" AND (network OR router OR switch) AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "neural model")
queries.rationale: Target studies on automated or LLM-assisted repair/patching of misconfigurations and rollbacks.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "generate and verify" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "agent")
queries.rationale: Retrieve architectural patterns combining generation with external validators or repairs—key mitigations against LLM errors.

queries.query: ("tool-assisted" OR "tool use" OR ReAct OR Toolformer) AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (operations OR NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Find agentic frameworks and tool-use methods enabling LLMs to call validators, simulators, or network APIs.

queries.query: ("formal verification" OR "network verification" OR "Header Space Analysis" OR NetKAT OR Veriflow OR Batfish) AND (network configuration OR forwarding)
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic/network-verification tools and formalisms that can serve as validators for LLM outputs.

queries.query: "AIOps" OR "NetOps benchmarks" OR "network configuration benchmark" OR "OpsEval" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OWL"
queries.rationale: Survey existing benchmarks and datasets for automation/evaluation in operational networking contexts and their limitations.

queries.query: "hallucination" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR configuration OR "domain-specific hallucination")
queries.rationale: Identify literature on hallucination phenomena in LLMs, especially domain-specific errors relevant to NetOps.

queries.query: "self-correction" OR "LLM feedback loop" OR "iterative repair" AND (LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Gather methods for bounded iterative correction, re-prompting, and verifier-guided fixes applicable to NetOps workflows.

queries.query: "benchmark validity" OR "ecological validity" OR "construct validity" AND (benchmark OR evaluation) AND (LLM OR "language model" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Find methodological work on when benchmarks reflect real-world operational validity and common pitfalls to avoid in NetOps evaluations.

queries.query: "simulation environment" OR emulator OR "network emulator" OR Mininet OR CORE OR GNS3 AND (for evaluation OR testbed) AND (NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify emulation/testbed platforms used to evaluate network configurations and how well they emulate production behavior for validation.
source_preferences: USENIX, SIGCOMM, NSDI papers, GitHub, arXiv

queries.query: "safety" OR "reliability" OR "robustness" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR agent) AND (operations OR automation)
queries.rationale: Broaden to ML-safety and robustness literature that addresses automated operational agents and mitigations applicable to NetOps.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" AND (NetOps OR network OR "configuration management") AND (LLM OR automation OR agent)
queries.rationale: Discover hybrid workflows combining human oversight with automated LLM agents in NetOps operations and their effect on trustworthiness.
source_preferences: ACM/IEEE conferences, arXiv, industry case studies with reproducible methods

queries.query: "failure modes" OR "error analysis" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (downstream OR "task-specific" OR "domain-specific")
queries.rationale: Collect systematic analyses of LLM failure modes and diagnostics approaches applicable to network-domain tasks.
source_preferences: arXiv, ACL, NeurIPS, empirical studies in top conferences

queries.query: "bounded agent" OR "guarded agent" OR "constrained generation" AND (LLM OR agent) AND (operations OR network)
queries.rationale: Find architectural/algorithmic mitigations that bound agentic behavior (policy constraints, sandboxing) relevant to safe NetOps automation.

queries.query: ("dataset" OR "corpus") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "config files") AND (public OR benchmark OR dataset)
queries.rationale: Locate public datasets of network configurations, change histories, or operator intents that can support reproducible evaluation.
source_preferences: GitHub, Zenodo, dataset repositories, IEEE/ACM papers

inclusion_criteria: English-language technical sources (peer-reviewed papers, conference/workshop proceedings, arXiv preprints, technical reports)
Works published 2018–2026 for ML+NetOps material; include foundational pre-2018 works for network verification or formal methods when directly relevant
Empirical studies, reproducible method descriptions, datasets, and open-source tool repositories (GitHub/Zenodo)
Papers describing LLM/agent architectures, tool-assisted LLM methods, generate-validate-repair pipelines, or NetOps-specific evaluations
Documentation or papers for established network verification/emulation tools (Batfish, Veriflow, NetKAT, Mininet)
Benchmarks and critical methodological analyses of benchmark validity and ecological/construct validity
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials, vendor whitepapers without technical detail or reproducible artifacts (unless they include technical references or open repos)
Non-technical opinion pieces, blog posts lacking citations or reproducible method details (may be used for leads but excluded from evidence corpus)
Proprietary datasets or evaluation results inaccessible for reproduction (flag but exclude as primary evidence)
Works outside the NetOps/operational-networking domain with no transferable methodology or clear relevance (e.g., general chatbot UX studies)
Non-English-only sources unless an English translation or sufficient technical excerpts are available
date_rationale: Focus on 2018–2026 for ML/LLM–NetOps convergence (LLM capabilities and agentic tool-use rose sharply after 2020). Include earlier foundational network-verification and formal-methods work (pre-2018) because those methods remain essential validators for configuration correctness.
